validity.researcher_notes: GEM records Owner1='Gassled' at 100%. Gassled is the Norwegian offshore gas-transport joint venture for the Norwegian continental shelf (created 2002, operational 2003, operated by Gassco; Norwegian state took it to 100% in a 2024 deal) — confirmed via en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gassled and offshore-technology/pgjonline coverage of the 2024 takeover. It has zero connection to a Qatar->Turkey pipeline. This is almost certainly stray/contaminated data, not a real attribution. The Qatar-Turkey line was a Qatari government / Qatar Petroleum proposal sourced from the Qatari-Iranian North Field (South Pars/North Dome); no operating owner ever existed because the pipeline was never built. Recommend deleting the Gassled owner entirely (or, if an owner must be present, recording the Qatari state / QatarEnergy as proposer, not 'owner').

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed as a real 2009 PROPOSAL (never built) by >=3 independent sources: The National (2009, thenationalnews.com/business/qatar-seeks-gas-pipeline-to-turkey-1.520795) reports Qatar seeking a pipeline to Turkey via Saudi Arabia + Jordan + Syria (or via Saudi Arabia/Kuwait/Iraq), to hook into Nabucco, sourced from the North Field; The Guardian (2013) and Turkiye Today (2025) both reference the ~1,500 km, ~$10 billion proposal and the contention that Assad's 2009 refusal to sign (to protect Russian gas interests) is tied to the Syria conflict narrative. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas (dry) TRANSMISSION trunk-line proposal — corroborated. DUPLICATE: no duplicate in the 65-row Saudi gas roster — every other row is a domestic Saudi Aramco line (MGS, UBTG, East-West, Hawiyah/Uthmaniya etc.); none describes a Qatar->Turkey international trunk, so P0458 is unique. SPEC: Length 1,500 km and SegmentCost $10bn (2009) are corroborated by Turkiye Today (2025) and matched against secondary coverage (Middle East Eye, AVIM); The National (2009, the contemporaneous primary) does NOT state the length or cost figure, so the 1500 km / $10bn pair rests on later sources that may share a common lineage — treat as medium-confidence on the exact numbers though the project's existence is high-confidence. FuelSource 'North Field' confirmed (The National; same field as South Pars/North Dome). Endpoints North Field (Qatar) -> Nabucco Pipeline (Turkiye) confirmed (The National: 'might hook up with Nabucco at its proposed starting point in eastern Turkey'). STATUS caveat: GEM has cancelled + Shelved 2009; the 2009 deal lapsed and was never built, so 'cancelled' is defensible, BUT Turkiye Today (Jan 2025) reports Qatar publicly DENYING revived plans amid post-Assad speculation — i.e. it remains a dormant/denied proposal rather than a formally cancelled government project. 'cancelled/shelved 2009' is acceptable but slightly overstates finality; acceptable to keep.
